change: PERFORMANCE: found the cause of slow/delayed response while punching jobs. refreshWorkerBoard() -- called after every single job Start/Complete punch, 10 call sites total -- was calling getOpenJobLocksFor() once per staff member (~76 people), and each call independently re-scanned the entire inspections history with a nested entries lookup inside. That's ~76 full history scans on every punch. Replaced with a single combined pass (getAllOpenJobLocksGrouped) that computes the same result for all workers in one scan instead of 76. Should make Start/Complete punches feel noticeably snappier, especially on older/slower devices.
